principles.heading: ## Design Principles
principles.intro: Composition rules for using these tokens, derived from the extracted values.

proximity.heading: ### Proximity
proximity.related: - Keep related items within `{{related}}`; separate groups with `{{group}}` or more
proximity.group: - Group with space from the scale instead of adding divider lines

alignment.heading: ### Alignment
alignment.scale: - Align repeated blocks to shared edges; size and space with the scale steps, never off-scale values
alignment.text: - Keep text columns on one inline start within a section

repetition.heading: ### Repetition
repetition.scale: - Reuse the extracted scale exactly ({{counts}}) — never invent near-duplicate values
repetition.coherence: - Coherence comes from repeating the same tokens, not from decorating individual elements

contrast.heading: ### Contrast
contrast.muted: - Use the foreground color for primary text and the muted color for secondary text
contrast.textRange: - Establish text hierarchy with the darkest and lightest extracted text colors, not size alone
contrast.primary: - Reserve the primary color for one key action per view; supporting actions stay neutral
contrast.states: - Keep hover, focus, and selected states in the same hue family as the action color

dos.heading: ### Do's
dos.colorTokens: - ✅ Use the defined color tokens instead of hardcoded hex values
dos.spacingScale: - ✅ Follow the spacing scale for consistent rhythm
dos.primaryFont: - ✅ Use `{{font}}` as the primary font stack
dos.generousRadius: - ✅ Use generous border-radius for a soft, friendly feel
dos.compactPillRadius: - ✅ Use compact radii on ordinary surfaces; preserve observed pill and circular button variants separately
dos.compactRadius: - ✅ Keep border-radius minimal for a sharp, precise aesthetic
dos.shadows: - ✅ Use elevation (shadows) to create visual hierarchy
dos.noShadowScale: - ✅ No stable shadow scale was observed; prefer observed borders and background shifts for hierarchy
dos.observedResponsive: - ✅ Preserve the observed responsive behavior across viewports
dos.declaredBreakpoints: - Breakpoints were declared, but responsive behavior was not observed in this capture
dos.recurringSpacing: - ✅ Use the spacing scale for recurring rhythm; keep observed component and structural exceptions exact

donts.heading: ### Don'ts
donts.derivedColors: - ❌ Don't present new colors as observed values; label and validate derived accessibility recommendations separately
donts.newColors: - ❌ Don't introduce new colors outside the defined palette
donts.fontFamilies: - ❌ Don't mix multiple font families — stick to the single typeface

coverage.scopeLine: Coverage: {{capturedUrls}}/{{selectedUrls}} selected URLs observed; page×viewport captures {{capturedCaptures}}/{{expectedCaptures}} ({{captureStatus}}); {{sections}} section observations and {{components}} component observations across captures (not page instance counts)

transfer.intro: > Business requirements determine content and behavior. This contract constrains only the observed visual and interaction language within its stated scope.

instructions.p0: Apply P0 rules by default within their stated scope.
instructions.p1: Apply a P1 recipe only when the target contains the matching component and variant.
instructions.p2: Treat P2 as local evidence; it must not override P0 or P1.
instructions.brand: Do not copy source branding, logos, copy, or media.
instructions.accessibility: Accessibility, correct product behavior, and explicit user requirements take priority.

transfer.p0Empty: - No foundation met the cross-page, high-confidence requirement. Use exact tokens as observed values, not as global transfer rules.

transfer.componentsIntro: > These recipes are not global defaults. Use one only when the target contains the matching component and variant. Keep each treatment scoped to that component and variant; when no state is listed, do not present an invented state as a source rule.

principles.heading: Design principles
principles.intro: Composition rules for these tokens, derived from the theme values.
principles.proximityScale: - Keep related items within `calc({{unit}} * 2)`; separate groups with `calc({{unit}} * 6)` or more
principles.proximityDensity: - Group with the spacing scale instead of stacking dividers (density: {{density}})
principles.alignmentScale: - Size and space in multiples of {{unit}}; never use off-scale values
principles.alignmentSidebar: - Repeated blocks share one inline start and column width (sidebar {{sidebarWidth}})
principles.semanticSteps: - Reuse existing semantic token steps (colors, font sizes, radii, shadows); never invent near-duplicates
principles.textContrast: - Body text uses `--color-foreground`, secondary text `--color-muted-foreground`; hierarchy comes from contrast, not font-size stacking
principles.actionContrast: - One primary action per view (`--color-primary`); hover, selected, and focus states stay in the primary hue family — the signature contrast color appears only in the focus ring and selection indicators

rules.source: 1. Treat this document as the single source of truth for visual rules.

doRules.colors: - Use semantic color tokens (`--color-primary`), not hardcoded color values
